verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֗ע אֶת־ דִּבְרֵ֤י בְנֵֽי־ לָבָן֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לָקַ֣ח יַעֲקֹ֔ב אֵ֖ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְאָבִ֑ינוּ וּמֵאֲשֶׁ֣ר לְאָבִ֔ינוּ עָשָׂ֕ה אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַכָּבֹ֖ד הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ma‘ ’eṯ- diḇ·rê ḇə·nê- lā·ḇān lê·mōr lā·qaḥ ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer lə·’ā·ḇî·nū ū·mê·’ă·šer lə·’ā·ḇî·nū ‘ā·śāh ’êṯ kāl- hak·kā·ḇōḏ haz·zeh
verses.literal: Now Jacob heard that Laban’s . . . sons were saying Jacob has taken away all that belonged to our father and built all this wealth at our father’s expense
verses.literalPt: ENTÃO ouvia as palavras dos filhos de Labão, que diziam: Jacó tem tomado tudo o que era de nosso pai, e do que era de nosso pai fez ele toda esta glória.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥רְא יַעֲקֹ֖ב אֶת־ פְּנֵ֣י לָבָ֑ן וְהִנֵּ֥ה אֵינֶ֛נּוּ עִמּ֖וֹ כִּתְמ֥וֹל שִׁלְשֽׁוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’eṯ- pə·nê lā·ḇān wə·hin·nêh ’ê·nen·nū ‘im·mōw kiṯ·mō·wl šil·šō·wm
verses.literal: And Jacob saw from the countenance of Laban . . . that his attitude toward him . . . had changed
verses.literalPt: Viu também Jacó o rosto de Labão, e eis que não era para com ele como anteriormente.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶֽל־ יַעֲקֹ֔ב שׁ֛וּב אֶל־ אֶ֥רֶץ אֲבוֹתֶ֖יךָ וּלְמוֹלַדְתֶּ֑ךָ וְאֶֽהְיֶ֖ה עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- ya·‘ă·qōḇ šūḇ ’el- ’e·reṣ ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯe·ḵā ū·lə·mō·w·laḏ·te·ḵā wə·’eh·yeh ‘im·māḵ
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Jacob Go back to the land of your fathers and to your kindred and I will be with you
verses.literalPt: E disse o SENHOR a Jacó: Torna-te à terra dos teus pais, e à tua parentela, e eu serei contigo.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח יַעֲקֹ֔ב וַיִּקְרָ֖א לְרָחֵ֣ל וּלְלֵאָ֑ה הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה אֶל־ צֹאנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ ya·‘ă·qōḇ way·yiq·rā lə·rā·ḥêl ū·lə·lê·’āh haś·śā·ḏeh ’el- ṣō·nōw
verses.literal: So Jacob sent word and called Rachel and Leah to the field . . . where his flocks were
verses.literalPt: Então mandou Jacó chamar a Raquel e a Lia ao campo, para junto do seu rebanho,

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָהֶ֗ן רֹאֶ֤ה אָנֹכִי֙ אֶת־ פְּנֵ֣י אֲבִיכֶ֔ן כִּֽי־ אֵינֶ֥נּוּ אֵלַ֖י כִּתְמֹ֣ל שִׁלְשֹׁ֑ם וֵֽאלֹהֵ֣י אָבִ֔י הָיָ֖ה עִמָּדִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lā·hen rō·’eh ’ā·nō·ḵî ’eṯ- pə·nê ’ă·ḇî·ḵen kî- ’ê·nen·nū ’ê·lay kiṯ·mōl šil·šōm wê·lō·hê ’ā·ḇî hā·yāh ‘im·mā·ḏî
verses.literal: and he told them I can see from your father’s countenance that his attitude toward me has changed . . . . . . but the God of my father has been with me
verses.literalPt: E disse-lhes: Vejo que o rosto de vosso pai não é para comigo como anteriormente; porém o Deus de meu pai tem estado comigo;

verses.original: וְאַתֵּ֖נָה יְדַעְתֶּ֑ן כִּ֚י בְּכָל־ כֹּחִ֔י עָבַ֖דְתִּי אֶת־ אֲבִיכֶֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tê·nāh yə·ḏa‘·ten kî bə·ḵāl kō·ḥî ‘ā·ḇaḏ·tî ’eṯ- ’ă·ḇî·ḵen
verses.literal: You know that I have served your father with all my strength
verses.literalPt: E vós mesmas sabeis que com todo o meu esforço tenho servido a vosso pai;

verses.original: וַאֲבִיכֶן֙ הֵ֣תֶל בִּ֔י וְהֶחֱלִ֥ף אֶת־ מַשְׂכֻּרְתִּ֖י עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת מֹנִ֑ים וְלֹֽא־ נְתָנ֣וֹ אֱלֹהִ֔ים לְהָרַ֖ע עִמָּדִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·ḇî·ḵen hê·ṯel bî wə·he·ḥĕ·lip̄ ’eṯ- maś·kur·tî ‘ă·śe·reṯ mō·nîm wə·lō- nə·ṯā·nōw ’ĕ·lō·hîm lə·hā·ra‘ ‘im·mā·ḏî
verses.literal: And although he has cheated me and changed my wages ten times God has not allowed him to harm me . . .
verses.literalPt: Mas vosso pai me enganou e mudou o salário dez vezes; porém Deus não lhe permitiu que me fizesse mal.

verses.original: אִם־ כֹּ֣ה יֹאמַ֗ר נְקֻדִּים֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה שְׂכָרֶ֔ךָ וְיָלְד֥וּ כָל־ הַצֹּ֖אן נְקֻדִּ֑ים וְאִם־ כֹּ֣ה יֹאמַ֗ר עֲקֻדִּים֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה שְׂכָרֶ֔ךָ וְיָלְד֥וּ כָל־ הַצֹּ֖אן עֲקֻדִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- kōh yō·mar nə·qud·dîm yih·yeh śə·ḵā·re·ḵā wə·yā·lə·ḏū ḵāl haṣ·ṣōn nə·qud·dîm wə·’im- kōh yō·mar ‘ă·qud·dîm yih·yeh śə·ḵā·re·ḵā wə·yā·lə·ḏū ḵāl haṣ·ṣōn ‘ă·qud·dîm
verses.literal: If . . . he said The speckled will be your wages then the whole flock bore speckled offspring If . . . he said The streaked will be your wages then the whole flock bore streaked offspring
verses.literalPt: Quando ele dizia assim: Os salpicados serão o teu salário; então todos os rebanhos davam salpicados. E quando ele dizia assim: Os listrados serão o teu salário, então todos os rebanhos davam listrados.

verses.original: וַיַּצֵּ֧ל אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶת־ מִקְנֵ֥ה אֲבִיכֶ֖ם וַיִּתֶּן־ לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaṣ·ṣêl ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- miq·nêh ’ă·ḇî·ḵem way·yit·ten- lî
verses.literal: Thus God has taken away your father’s livestock and given them to me
verses.literalPt: Assim Deus tirou o gado de vosso pai, e deu-o a mim.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י בְּעֵת֙ יַחֵ֣ם הַצֹּ֔אן וָאֶשָּׂ֥א עֵינַ֛י וָאֵ֖רֶא בַּחֲל֑וֹם וְהִנֵּ֤ה הָֽעַתֻּדִים֙ הָעֹלִ֣ים עַל־ הַצֹּ֔אן עֲקֻדִּ֥ים נְקֻדִּ֖ים וּבְרֻדִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bə·‘êṯ ya·ḥêm haṣ·ṣōn wā·’eś·śā ‘ê·nay wā·’ê·re ba·ḥă·lō·wm wə·hin·nêh hā·‘at·tu·ḏîm hā·‘ō·lîm ‘al- haṣ·ṣōn ‘ă·qud·dîm nə·qud·dîm ū·ḇə·rud·dîm
verses.literal: When the flocks were breeding I saw . . . . . . in a dream . . . that the streaked spotted and speckled males were mating with the females
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que, ao tempo em que o rebanho concebia, eu levantei os meus olhos e vi em sonhos, e eis que os bodes, que cobriam as ovelhas, eram listrados, salpicados e malhados.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלַ֜י מַלְאַ֧ךְ הָאֱלֹהִ֛ים בַּחֲל֖וֹם יַֽעֲקֹ֑ב וָאֹמַ֖ר הִנֵּֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lay mal·’aḵ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ba·ḥă·lō·wm ya·‘ă·qōḇ wā·’ō·mar hin·nê·nî
verses.literal: In that dream the angel of God said to me Jacob And I replied Here I am.
verses.literalPt: E disse-me o anjo de Deus em sonhos: Jacó! E eu disse: Eis-me aqui.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר שָׂא־ נָ֨א עֵינֶ֤יךָ וּרְאֵה֙ כָּל־ הָֽעַתֻּדִים֙ הָעֹלִ֣ים עַל־ הַצֹּ֔אן עֲקֻדִּ֥ים נְקֻדִּ֖ים וּבְרֻדִּ֑ים כִּ֣י רָאִ֔יתִי אֵ֛ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָבָ֖ן עֹ֥שֶׂה לָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer śā- nā ‘ê·ne·ḵā ū·rə·’êh kāl- hā·‘at·tu·ḏîm hā·‘ō·lîm ‘al- haṣ·ṣōn ‘ă·qud·dîm nə·qud·dîm ū·ḇə·rud·dîm kî rā·’î·ṯî ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer lā·ḇān ‘ō·śeh lāḵ
verses.literal: Look up . . . . . . he said and see that all the males that are mating with the flock are streaked spotted or speckled for I have seen all that Laban has done to you
verses.literalPt: E disse ele: Levanta agora os teus olhos e vê todos os bodes que cobrem o rebanho, que são listrados, salpicados e malhados; porque tenho visto tudo o que Labão te fez.

verses.original: אָנֹכִ֤י הָאֵל֙ בֵּֽית־ אֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר מָשַׁ֤חְתָּ שָּׁם֙ מַצֵּבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָדַ֥רְתָּ לִּ֛י שָׁ֖ם נֶ֑דֶר עַתָּ֗ה ק֥וּם צֵא֙ מִן־ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את וְשׁ֖וּב אֶל־ אֶ֥רֶץ מוֹלַדְתֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·nō·ḵî hā·’êl bêṯ- ’êl ’ă·šer mā·šaḥ·tā šām maṣ·ṣê·ḇāh ’ă·šer nā·ḏar·tā lî šām ne·ḏer ‘at·tāh qūm ṣê min- hā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ wə·šūḇ ’el- ’e·reṣ mō·w·laḏ·te·ḵā
verses.literal: I am the God of Bethel where you anointed . . . the pillar and made . . . a solemn vow to Me Now get up leave . . . this land at once and return to your native land
verses.literalPt: Eu sou o Deus de Betel, onde tens ungido uma coluna, onde me fizeste um voto; levanta-te agora, sai-te desta terra e torna-te à terra da tua parentela.

verses.original: וַתַּ֤עַן רָחֵל֙ וְלֵאָ֔ה וַתֹּאמַ֖רְנָה ל֑וֹ הַע֥וֹד לָ֛נוּ חֵ֥לֶק וְנַחֲלָ֖ה בְּבֵ֥ית אָבִֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·ta·‘an rā·ḥêl wə·lê·’āh wat·tō·mar·nāh lōw ha·‘ō·wḏ lā·nū ḥê·leq wə·na·ḥă·lāh bə·ḇêṯ ’ā·ḇî·nū
verses.literal: And Rachel and Leah replied . . . Do we have any portion or inheritance left in our father’s house
verses.literalPt: Então responderam Raquel e Lia e disseram-lhe: Há ainda para nós parte ou herança na casa de nosso pai?

verses.original: הֲל֧וֹא נָכְרִיּ֛וֹת נֶחְשַׁ֥בְנוּ ל֖וֹ כִּ֣י מְכָרָ֑נוּ וַיֹּ֥אכַל גַּם־ אָכ֖וֹל אֶת־ כַּסְפֵּֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō·w nā·ḵə·rî·yō·wṯ neḥ·šaḇ·nū lōw kî mə·ḵā·rā·nū way·yō·ḵal gam- ’ā·ḵō·wl ’eṯ- kas·pê·nū
verses.literal: Are we not regarded by him as outsiders Not only has he sold us but he has certainly squandered . . . what was paid for us
verses.literalPt: Não nos considera ele como estranhas? Pois vendeu-nos, e comeu de todo o nosso dinheiro.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כָל־ הָעֹ֗שֶׁר אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִצִּ֤יל אֱלֹהִים֙ מֵֽאָבִ֔ינוּ לָ֥נוּ ה֖וּא וּלְבָנֵ֑ינוּ וְעַתָּ֗ה כֹּל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָמַ֧ר אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֵלֶ֖יךָ עֲשֵֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵāl hā·‘ō·šer ’ă·šer hiṣ·ṣîl ’ĕ·lō·hîm mê·’ā·ḇî·nū lā·nū hū ū·lə·ḇā·nê·nū wə·‘at·tāh kōl ’ă·šer ’ā·mar ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ê·le·ḵā ‘ă·śêh
verses.literal: Surely all the wealth that God has taken away from our father belongs to us . . . and to our children So do whatever God has told you
verses.literalPt: Porque toda a riqueza, que Deus tirou de nosso pai, é nossa e de nossos filhos; agora, pois, faze tudo o que Deus te mandou.

verses.original: וַיָּ֖קָם יַעֲקֹ֑ב וַיִּשָּׂ֛א אֶת־ בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶת־ נָשָׁ֖יו עַל־ הַגְּמַלִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qām ya·‘ă·qōḇ way·yiś·śā ’eṯ- bā·nāw wə·’eṯ- nā·šāw ‘al- hag·gə·mal·lîm
verses.literal: Then Jacob got up and put his children and his wives on camels
verses.literalPt: Então se levantou Jacó, pondo os seus filhos e as suas mulheres sobre os camelos;

verses.original: וַיִּנְהַ֣ג אֶת־ כָּל־ מִקְנֵ֗הוּ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ רְכֻשׁוֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָכָ֔שׁ מִקְנֵה֙ קִנְיָנ֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָכַ֖שׁ בְּפַדַּ֣ן אֲרָ֑ם לָב֛וֹא אֶל־ יִצְחָ֥ק אָבִ֖יו אַ֥רְצָה כְּנָֽעַן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yin·haḡ ’eṯ- kāl- miq·nê·hū wə·’eṯ- kāl- rə·ḵu·šōw ’ă·šer rā·ḵāš miq·nêh qin·yā·nōw ’ă·šer rā·ḵaš bə·p̄ad·dan ’ă·rām lā·ḇō·w ’el- yiṣ·ḥāq ’ā·ḇîw ’ar·ṣāh kə·nā·‘an
verses.literal: and he drove all his livestock before him - . . . - . . . along with all the possessions he had acquired in Paddan-aram to go to his father Isaac in the land in Canaan
verses.literalPt: E levou todo o seu gado, e todos os seus bens, que havia adquirido, o gado que possuía, que alcançara em Padã-Arã, para ir a Isaque, seu pai, à terra de Canaã.

verses.original: וְלָבָ֣ן הָלַ֔ךְ לִגְזֹ֖ז אֶת־ צֹאנ֑וֹ וַתִּגְנֹ֣ב רָחֵ֔ל אֶת־ הַתְּרָפִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְאָבִֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·ḇān hā·laḵ liḡ·zōz ’eṯ- ṣō·nōw wat·tiḡ·nōḇ rā·ḥêl ’eṯ- hat·tə·rā·p̄îm ’ă·šer lə·’ā·ḇî·hā
verses.literal: Now while Laban was out shearing his sheep Rachel stole her father’s household idols
verses.literalPt: E havendo Labão ido a tosquiar as suas ovelhas, furtou Raquel os ídolos que seu pai tinha.

verses.original: וַיִּגְנֹ֣ב יַעֲקֹ֔ב אֶת־ לֵ֥ב לָבָ֖ן הָאֲרַמִּ֑י עַל־ בְּלִי֙ הִגִּ֣יד ל֔וֹ כִּ֥י בֹרֵ֖חַ הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiḡ·nōḇ ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’eṯ- lêḇ lā·ḇān hā·’ă·ram·mî ‘al- bə·lî hig·gîḏ lōw kî ḇō·rê·aḥ hū
verses.literal: Moreover, Jacob deceived . . . Laban the Aramean . . . by not telling him that he was running away
verses.literalPt: E Jacó logrou a Labão, o arameu, porque não lhe fez saber que fugia.

verses.original: וַיִּבְרַ֥ח הוּא֙ וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁר־ ל֔וֹ וַיָּ֖קָם וַיַּעֲבֹ֣ר אֶת־ הַנָּהָ֑ר וַיָּ֥שֶׂם אֶת־ פָּנָ֖יו הַ֥ר הַגִּלְעָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiḇ·raḥ hū wə·ḵāl ’ă·šer- lōw way·yā·qām way·ya·‘ă·ḇōr ’eṯ- han·nā·hār way·yā·śem ’eṯ- pā·nāw har hag·gil·‘āḏ
verses.literal: So he fled with all his possessions crossed the Euphrates and headed for - the hill country of Gilead
verses.literalPt: E fugiu ele com tudo o que tinha, e levantou-se e passou o rio; e se dirigiu para a montanha de Gileade.

verses.original: וַיֻּגַּ֥ד לְלָבָ֖ן בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֑י כִּ֥י בָרַ֖ח יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yug·gaḏ lə·lā·ḇān bay·yō·wm haš·šə·lî·šî kî ḇā·raḥ ya·‘ă·qōḇ
verses.literal: On the third day Laban was informed that Jacob had fled
verses.literalPt: E no terceiro dia foi anunciado a Labão que Jacó tinha fugido.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֤ח אֶת־ אֶחָיו֙ עִמּ֔וֹ וַיִּרְדֹּ֣ף אַחֲרָ֔יו דֶּ֖רֶךְ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים וַיַּדְבֵּ֥ק אֹת֖וֹ בְּהַ֥ר הַגִּלְעָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- ’e·ḥāw ‘im·mōw way·yir·dōp̄ ’a·ḥă·rāw de·reḵ šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm way·yaḏ·bêq ’ō·ṯōw bə·har hag·gil·‘āḏ
verses.literal: So he took his relatives with him pursued Jacob . . . for seven days and overtook him in the hill country of Gilead
verses.literalPt: Então tomou consigo os seus irmãos, e atrás dele seguiu o seu caminho por sete dias; e alcançou-o na montanha de Gileade.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֧א אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶל־ לָבָ֥ן הָאֲרַמִּ֖י בַּחֲלֹ֣ם הַלָּ֑יְלָה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ הִשָּׁ֧מֶר לְךָ֛ פֶּן־ תְּדַבֵּ֥ר עִֽם־ יַעֲקֹ֖ב מִטּ֥וֹב עַד־ רָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’el- lā·ḇān hā·’ă·ram·mî ba·ḥă·lōm hal·lā·yə·lāh way·yō·mer lōw hiš·šā·mer lə·ḵā pen- tə·ḏab·bêr ‘im- ya·‘ă·qōḇ miṭ·ṭō·wḇ ‘aḏ- rā‘
verses.literal: But that night God came to Laban the Aramean in a dream and warned him Be careful not to say anything to Jacob either good or bad
verses.literalPt: Veio, porém, Deus a Labão, o arameu, em sonhos, de noite, e disse-lhe: Guarda-te, que não fales com Jacó nem bem nem mal.

verses.original: וַיַּשֵּׂ֥ג לָבָ֖ן אֶֽת־ יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְיַעֲקֹ֗ב תָּקַ֤ע אֶֽת־ אָהֳלוֹ֙ בָּהָ֔ר וְלָבָ֛ן תָּקַ֥ע אֶת־ אֶחָ֖יו בְּהַ֥ר הַגִּלְעָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaś·śêḡ lā·ḇān ’eṯ- ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ tā·qa‘ ’eṯ- ’ā·ho·lōw bā·hār wə·lā·ḇān tā·qa‘ ’eṯ- ’e·ḥāw bə·har hag·gil·‘āḏ
verses.literal: Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the hill country of Gilead when Laban overtook him and Laban and his relatives camped . . . there as well
verses.literalPt: Alcançou, pois, Labão a Jacó, e armara Jacó a sua tenda naquela montanha; armou também Labão com os seus irmãos a sua, na montanha de Gileade.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לָבָן֙ לְיַעֲקֹ֔ב מֶ֣ה עָשִׂ֔יתָ וַתִּגְנֹ֖ב אֶת־ לְבָבִ֑י וַתְּנַהֵג֙ אֶת־ בְּנֹתַ֔י כִּשְׁבֻי֖וֹת חָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lā·ḇān lə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ meh ‘ā·śî·ṯā wat·tiḡ·nōḇ ’eṯ- lə·ḇā·ḇî wat·tə·na·hêḡ ’eṯ- bə·nō·ṯay kiš·ḇu·yō·wṯ ḥā·reḇ
verses.literal: Then Laban said to Jacob What have you done You have deceived me . . . and carried off my daughters . . . like captives of war
verses.literalPt: Então disse Labão a Jacó: Que fizeste, que me lograste e levaste as minhas filhas como cativas pela espada?

verses.original: לָ֤מָּה נַחְבֵּ֙אתָ֙ לִבְרֹ֔חַ וַתִּגְנֹ֖ב אֹתִ֑י וְלֹא־ הִגַּ֣דְתָּ לִּ֔י וָֽאֲשַׁלֵּחֲךָ֛ בְּשִׂמְחָ֥ה וּבְשִׁרִ֖ים בְּתֹ֥ף וּבְכִנּֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: lām·māh naḥ·bê·ṯā liḇ·rō·aḥ wat·tiḡ·nōḇ ’ō·ṯî wə·lō- hig·gaḏ·tā lî wā·’ă·šal·lê·ḥă·ḵā bə·śim·ḥāh ū·ḇə·ši·rîm bə·ṯōp̄ ū·ḇə·ḵin·nō·wr
verses.literal: Why did you run away secretly and deceive me without even telling me I would have sent you away with joy and singing with tambourines and harps
verses.literalPt: Por que fugiste ocultamente, e lograste-me, e não me fizeste saber, para que eu te enviasse com alegria, e com cânticos, e com tamboril e com harpa?

verses.original: וְלֹ֣א נְטַשְׁתַּ֔נִי לְנַשֵּׁ֥ק לְבָנַ֖י וְלִבְנֹתָ֑י עַתָּ֖ה הִסְכַּ֥לְתָּֽ עֲשֽׂוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō nə·ṭaš·ta·nî lə·naš·šêq lə·ḇā·nay wə·liḇ·nō·ṯāy ‘at·tāh his·kal·tā ‘ă·śōw
verses.literal: But you did not even let me kiss my grandchildren and my daughters goodbye Now you have done a foolish thing
verses.literalPt: Também não me permitiste beijar os meus filhos e as minhas filhas. Loucamente agiste, agora, fazendo assim.

verses.original: יֶשׁ־ לְאֵ֣ל יָדִ֔י לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת עִמָּכֶ֖ם רָ֑ע וֵֽאלֹהֵ֨י אֲבִיכֶ֜ם אֶ֣מֶשׁ׀ אָמַ֧ר אֵלַ֣י לֵאמֹ֗ר הִשָּׁ֧מֶר לְךָ֛ מִדַּבֵּ֥ר עִֽם־ יַעֲקֹ֖ב מִטּ֥וֹב עַד־ רָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: yeš- lə·’êl yā·ḏî la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ‘im·mā·ḵem rā‘ wê·lō·hê ’ă·ḇî·ḵem ’e·meš ’ā·mar ’ê·lay lê·mōr hiš·šā·mer lə·ḵā mid·dab·bêr ‘im- ya·‘ă·qōḇ miṭ·ṭō·wḇ ‘aḏ- rā‘
verses.literal: I have power to do . . . . . . you great harm but last night the God of your father said to me . . . Be careful not to say anything to Jacob either good or bad
verses.literalPt: Poder havia em minha mão para vos fazer mal, mas o Deus de vosso pai me falou ontem à noite, dizendo: Guarda-te, que não fales com Jacó nem bem nem mal.

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֙ הָלֹ֣ךְ הָלַ֔כְתָּ כִּֽי־ נִכְסֹ֥ף נִכְסַ֖פְתָּה לְבֵ֣ית אָבִ֑יךָ לָ֥מָּה גָנַ֖בְתָּ אֶת־ אֱלֹהָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh hā·lōḵ hā·laḵ·tā kî- niḵ·sōp̄ niḵ·sap̄·tāh lə·ḇêṯ ’ā·ḇî·ḵā lām·māh ḡā·naḇ·tā ’eṯ- ’ĕ·lō·hāy
verses.literal: Now you have gone off . . . because you long . . . for your father’s house But why have you stolen my gods
verses.literalPt: E agora se querias ir embora, porquanto tinhas saudades de voltar à casa de teu pai, por que furtaste os meus deuses?

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַן יַעֲקֹ֖ב וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לְלָבָ֑ן כִּ֣י יָרֵ֔אתִי כִּ֣י אָמַ֔רְתִּי פֶּן־ תִּגְזֹ֥ל אֶת־ בְּנוֹתֶ֖יךָ מֵעִמִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an ya·‘ă·qōḇ way·yō·mer lə·lā·ḇān kî yā·rê·ṯî kî ’ā·mar·tî pen- tiḡ·zōl ’eṯ- bə·nō·w·ṯe·ḵā mê·‘im·mî
verses.literal: I was afraid Jacob answered for . . . . . . I thought you would take your daughters from me by force
verses.literalPt: Então respondeu Jacó, e disse a Labão: Porque temia; pois que dizia comigo, se porventura não me arrebatarias as tuas filhas.

verses.original: עִ֠ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּמְצָ֣א אֶת־ אֱלֹהֶיךָ֮ לֹ֣א יִֽחְיֶה֒ נֶ֣גֶד אַחֵ֧ינוּ הַֽכֶּר־ לְךָ֛ מָ֥ה עִמָּדִ֖י וְקַֽח־ לָ֑ךְ וְלֹֽא־ יָדַ֣ע יַעֲקֹ֔ב כִּ֥י רָחֵ֖ל גְּנָבָֽתַם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘im ’ă·šer tim·ṣā ’eṯ- ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā lō yiḥ·yeh ne·ḡeḏ ’a·ḥê·nū hak·ker- lə·ḵā māh ‘im·mā·ḏî wə·qaḥ- lāḵ wə·lō- yā·ḏa‘ ya·‘ă·qōḇ kî rā·ḥêl gə·nā·ḇā·ṯam
verses.literal: If you find your gods with anyone here he shall not live In the presence of our relatives see for yourself if anything is yours and take it back For Jacob did not know that Rachel had stolen the idols
verses.literalPt: Com quem achares os teus deuses, esse não viva; reconhece diante de nossos irmãos o que é teu do que está comigo, e toma-o para ti. Pois Jacó não sabia que Raquel os tinha furtado.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֨א לָבָ֜ן בְּאֹ֥הֶל יַעֲקֹ֣ב׀ וּבְאֹ֣הֶל לֵאָ֗ה וּבְאֹ֛הֶל שְׁתֵּ֥י הָאֲמָהֹ֖ת וְלֹ֣א מָצָ֑א וַיֵּצֵא֙ מֵאֹ֣הֶל לֵאָ֔ה וַיָּבֹ֖א בְּאֹ֥הֶל רָחֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō lā·ḇān bə·’ō·hel ya·‘ă·qōḇ ū·ḇə·’ō·hel lê·’āh ū·ḇə·’ō·hel šə·tê hā·’ă·mā·hōṯ wə·lō mā·ṣā way·yê·ṣê mê·’ō·hel lê·’āh way·yā·ḇō bə·’ō·hel rā·ḥêl
verses.literal: So Laban went into Jacob’s tent then Leah’s tent and then the tents of the two maidservants but he found nothing Then he left Leah’s tent and entered Rachel’s tent
verses.literalPt: Então entrou Labão na tenda de Jacó, e na tenda de Lia, e na tenda de ambas as servas, e não os achou; e saindo da tenda de Lia, entrou na tenda de Raquel. 34 Mas tinha tomado Raquel os ídolos e os tinha posto na albarda de um camelo, e assentara-se sobre eles; e apalpou Labão toda a tenda, e não os achou.

verses.original: וְרָחֵ֞ל לָקְחָ֣ה אֶת־ הַתְּרָפִ֗ים וַתְּשִׂמֵ֛ם בְּכַ֥ר הַגָּמָ֖ל וַתֵּ֣שֶׁב עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וַיְמַשֵּׁ֥שׁ לָבָ֛ן אֶת־ כָּל־ הָאֹ֖הֶל וְלֹ֥א מָצָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·ḥêl lā·qə·ḥāh ’eṯ- hat·tə·rā·p̄îm wat·tə·śi·mêm bə·ḵar hag·gā·māl wat·tê·šeḇ ‘ă·lê·hem way·maš·šêš lā·ḇān ’eṯ- kāl- hā·’ō·hel wə·lō mā·ṣā
verses.literal: Now Rachel had taken Laban’s household idols put them in the saddlebag of her camel and was sitting on them And Laban searched everything in the tent but found nothing
verses.literalPt: Verszeile ohne Text

verses.original: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל־ אָבִ֗יהָ אַל־ יִ֙חַר֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י אֲדֹנִ֔י כִּ֣י ל֤וֹא אוּכַל֙ לָק֣וּם מִפָּנֶ֔יךָ כִּי־ דֶ֥רֶךְ נָשִׁ֖ים לִ֑י וַיְחַפֵּ֕שׂ וְלֹ֥א מָצָ֖א אֶת־ הַתְּרָפִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer ’el- ’ā·ḇî·hā ’al- yi·ḥar bə·‘ê·nê ’ă·ḏō·nî kî lō·w ’ū·ḵal lā·qūm mip·pā·ne·ḵā kî- ḏe·reḵ nā·šîm lî way·ḥap·pêś wə·lō mā·ṣā ’eṯ- hat·tə·rā·p̄îm
verses.literal: Rachel said to her father Sir do not be angry . . . that I cannot . . . stand up before you for I am having my period . . . So Laban searched but could not find the household idols
verses.literalPt: E ela disse a seu pai: Não se acenda a ira aos olhos de meu senhor, que não posso levantar-me diante da tua face; porquanto tenho o costume das mulheres. E ele procurou, mas não achou os ídolos.

verses.original: וַיִּ֥חַר לְיַעֲקֹ֖ב וַיָּ֣רֶב בְּלָבָ֑ן וַיַּ֤עַן יַעֲקֹב֙ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לְלָבָ֔ן מַה־ פִּשְׁעִי֙ מַ֣ה חַטָּאתִ֔י כִּ֥י דָלַ֖קְתָּ אַחֲרָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḥar lə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ way·yā·reḇ bə·lā·ḇān way·ya·‘an ya·‘ă·qōḇ way·yō·mer lə·lā·ḇān mah- piš·‘î mah ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯî kî ḏā·laq·tā ’a·ḥă·rāy
verses.literal: Then Jacob became incensed and challenged Laban . . . What is my crime he said For what sin of mine have you so hotly pursued me
verses.literalPt: Então irou-se Jacó e contendeu com Labão; e respondeu Jacó, e disse a Labão: Qual é a minha transgressão? Qual é o meu pecado, que tão furiosamente me tens perseguido?

verses.original: כִּֽי־ מִשַּׁ֣שְׁתָּ אֶת־ כָּל־ כֵּלַ֗י מַה־ מָּצָ֙אתָ֙ מִכֹּ֣ל כְּלֵי־ בֵיתֶ֔ךָ שִׂ֣ים כֹּ֔ה נֶ֥גֶד אַחַ֖י וְאַחֶ֑יךָ וְיוֹכִ֖יחוּ בֵּ֥ין שְׁנֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- miš·šaš·tā ’eṯ- kāl- kê·lay mah- mā·ṣā·ṯā mik·kōl kə·lê- ḇê·ṯe·ḵā śîm kōh ne·ḡeḏ ’a·ḥay wə·’a·ḥe·ḵā wə·yō·w·ḵî·ḥū bên šə·nê·nū
verses.literal: You have searched all my goods . . . Have you found anything that belongs to you . . . Put it here before my brothers and yours that they may judge between the two of us
verses.literalPt: Havendo apalpado todos os meus móveis, que achaste de todos os móveis de tua casa? Põe-no aqui diante dos meus irmãos e de teus irmãos; e que julguem entre nós ambos.

verses.original: זֶה֩ עֶשְׂרִ֨ים שָׁנָ֤ה אָנֹכִי֙ עִמָּ֔ךְ רְחֵלֶ֥יךָ וְעִזֶּ֖יךָ לֹ֣א שִׁכֵּ֑לוּ וְאֵילֵ֥י צֹאנְךָ֖ לֹ֥א אָכָֽלְתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: zeh ‘eś·rîm šā·nāh ’ā·nō·ḵî ‘im·māḵ rə·ḥê·le·ḵā wə·‘iz·ze·ḵā lō šik·kê·lū wə·’ê·lê ṣō·nə·ḵā lō ’ā·ḵā·lə·tî
verses.literal: I have been with you for twenty years now Your sheep and goats have not miscarried nor have I eaten the rams of your flock
verses.literalPt: Estes vinte anos eu estive contigo; as tuas ovelhas e as tuas cabras nunca abortaram, e não comi os carneiros do teu rebanho.

verses.original: טְרֵפָה֙ לֹא־ הֵבֵ֣אתִי אֵלֶ֔יךָ אָנֹכִ֣י אֲחַטֶּ֔נָּה מִיָּדִ֖י תְּבַקְשֶׁ֑נָּה גְּנֻֽבְתִ֣י י֔וֹם וּגְנֻֽבְתִ֖י לָֽיְלָה׃
verses.transliteration: ṭə·rê·p̄āh lō- hê·ḇê·ṯî ’ê·le·ḵā ’ā·nō·ḵî ’ă·ḥaṭ·ṭen·nāh mî·yā·ḏî tə·ḇaq·šen·nāh gə·nuḇ·ṯî yō·wm ū·ḡə·nuḇ·ṯî lā·yə·lāh
verses.literal: I did not bring you anything torn by wild beasts I bore the loss myself And you demanded payment from me for what was stolen by day . . . or night
verses.literalPt: Não te trouxe eu o despedaçado; eu o pagava; o furtado de dia e o furtado de noite da minha mão o requerias.

verses.original: הָיִ֧יתִי בַיּ֛וֹם אֲכָלַ֥נִי חֹ֖רֶב וְקֶ֣רַח בַּלָּ֑יְלָה וַתִּדַּ֥ד שְׁנָתִ֖י מֵֽעֵינָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: hā·yî·ṯî ḇay·yō·wm ’ă·ḵā·la·nî ḥō·reḇ wə·qe·raḥ bal·lā·yə·lāh wat·tid·daḏ šə·nā·ṯî mê·‘ê·nāy
verses.literal: As it was the heat consumed me by day and the frost by night and sleep fled from my eyes
verses.literalPt: Estava eu assim: De dia me consumia o calor, e de noite a geada; e o meu sono fugiu dos meus olhos.

verses.original: זֶה־ לִּ֞י עֶשְׂרִ֣ים שָׁנָה֮ בְּבֵיתֶךָ֒ עֲבַדְתִּ֜יךָ אַרְבַּֽע־ עֶשְׂרֵ֤ה שָׁנָה֙ בִּשְׁתֵּ֣י בְנֹתֶ֔יךָ וְשֵׁ֥שׁ שָׁנִ֖ים בְּצֹאנֶ֑ךָ וַתַּחֲלֵ֥ף אֶת־ מַשְׂכֻּרְתִּ֖י עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת מֹנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: zeh- lî ‘eś·rîm šā·nāh bə·ḇê·ṯe·ḵā ‘ă·ḇaḏ·tî·ḵā ’ar·ba‘- ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh biš·tê ḇə·nō·ṯe·ḵā wə·šêš šā·nîm bə·ṣō·ne·ḵā wat·ta·ḥă·lêp̄ ’eṯ- maś·kur·tî ‘ă·śe·reṯ mō·nîm
verses.literal: Thus for twenty years I have served in your household fourteen . . . years for your two daughters and six years for your flocks and you have changed my wages ten times
verses.literalPt: Tenho estado agora vinte anos na tua casa; catorze anos te servi por tuas duas filhas, e seis anos por teu rebanho; mas o meu salário tens mudado dez vezes.

verses.original: לוּלֵ֡י אֱלֹהֵ֣י אָבִי֩ אֱלֹהֵ֨י אַבְרָהָ֜ם וּפַ֤חַד יִצְחָק֙ הָ֣יָה לִ֔י כִּ֥י עַתָּ֖ה רֵיקָ֣ם שִׁלַּחְתָּ֑נִי אֶת־ עָנְיִ֞י וְאֶת־ יְגִ֧יעַ כַּפַּ֛י רָאָ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים וַיּ֥וֹכַח אָֽמֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: lū·lê ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ā·ḇî ’ĕ·lō·hê ’aḇ·rā·hām ū·p̄a·ḥaḏ yiṣ·ḥāq hā·yāh lî kî ‘at·tāh rê·qām šil·laḥ·tā·nî ’eṯ- ‘ā·nə·yî wə·’eṯ- yə·ḡī·aʿ kap·pay rā·’āh ’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yō·w·ḵaḥ ’ā·meš
verses.literal: If the God of my father the God of Abraham and the Fear of Isaac had not been with me surely by now you would have sent me away empty-handed But God has seen my affliction and the toil of my hands and last night He rendered judgment
verses.literalPt: Se o Deus de meu pai, o Deus de Abraão e o temor de Isaque não fora comigo, por certo me despedirias agora vazio. Deus atendeu à minha aflição, e ao trabalho das minhas mãos, e repreendeu-te ontem à noite.

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַן לָבָ֜ן וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֶֽל־ יַעֲקֹ֗ב הַבָּנ֨וֹת בְּנֹתַ֜י וְהַבָּנִ֤ים בָּנַי֙ וְהַצֹּ֣אן צֹאנִ֔י וְכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ אַתָּ֥ה רֹאֶ֖ה לִי־ ה֑וּא וְלִבְנֹתַ֞י מָֽה־ אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֤ה לָאֵ֙לֶּה֙ הַיּ֔וֹם א֥וֹ לִבְנֵיהֶ֖ן אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָלָֽדוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an lā·ḇān way·yō·mer ’el- ya·‘ă·qōḇ hab·bā·nō·wṯ bə·nō·ṯay wə·hab·bā·nîm bā·nay wə·haṣ·ṣōn ṣō·nî wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- ’at·tāh rō·’eh lî- hū wə·liḇ·nō·ṯay māh- ’e·‘ĕ·śeh lā·’êl·leh hay·yō·wm ’ōw liḇ·nê·hen ’ă·šer yā·lā·ḏū
verses.literal: But Laban . . . . . . answered Jacob These daughters are my daughters these sons are my sons and these flocks are my flocks Everything you see is mine Yet what can I do today about these daughters of mine or the children they have borne
verses.literalPt: Então respondeu Labão, e disse a Jacó: Estas filhas são minhas filhas, e estes filhos são meus filhos, e este rebanho é o meu rebanho, e tudo o que vês, é meu; e que farei hoje a estas minhas filhas, ou a seus filhos, que deram à luz?

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה לְכָ֛ה נִכְרְתָ֥ה בְרִ֖ית אֲנִ֣י וָאָ֑תָּה וְהָיָ֥ה לְעֵ֖ד בֵּינִ֥י וּבֵינֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh lə·ḵāh niḵ·rə·ṯāh ḇə·rîṯ ’ă·nî wā·’āt·tāh wə·hā·yāh lə·‘êḏ bê·nî ū·ḇê·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: Come now let us make a covenant you and I and let it serve as a witness between you and me . . .
verses.literalPt: Agora pois vem, e façamos aliança eu e tu, que seja por testemunho entre mim e ti.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֥ח יַעֲקֹ֖ב אָ֑בֶן וַיְרִימֶ֖הָ מַצֵּבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’ā·ḇen way·rî·me·hā maṣ·ṣê·ḇāh
verses.literal: So Jacob picked out a stone and set it up as a pillar
verses.literalPt: Então tomou Jacó uma pedra, e erigiu-a por coluna.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יַעֲקֹ֤ב לְאֶחָיו֙ לִקְט֣וּ אֲבָנִ֔ים וַיִּקְח֥וּ אֲבָנִ֖ים וַיַּֽעֲשׂוּ־ גָ֑ל וַיֹּ֥אכְלוּ שָׁ֖ם עַל־ הַגָּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ya·‘ă·qōḇ lə·’e·ḥāw liq·ṭū ’ă·ḇā·nîm way·yiq·ḥū ’ă·ḇā·nîm way·ya·‘ă·śū- ḡāl way·yō·ḵə·lū šām ‘al- hag·gāl
verses.literal: and he said to his relatives Gather some stones So they took stones and made a mound and there by the mound they ate
verses.literalPt: E disse Jacó a seus irmãos: Ajuntai pedras. E tomaram pedras, e fizeram um montão, e comeram ali sobre aquele montão.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָא־ ל֣וֹ לָבָ֔ן יְגַ֖ר שָׂהֲדוּתָ֑א וְיַֽעֲקֹ֔ב קָ֥רָא ל֖וֹ גַּלְעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā- lōw lā·ḇān yə·ḡar śā·hă·ḏū·ṯā wə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ qā·rā lōw gal·‘êḏ
verses.literal: Laban called it . . . Jegar-sahadutha and Jacob called it . . . Galeed
verses.literalPt: E chamou-o Labão Jegar-Saaduta; porém Jacó chamou-o Galeede.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָבָ֔ן הַגַּ֨ל הַזֶּ֥ה עֵ֛ד בֵּינִ֥י וּבֵינְךָ֖ הַיּ֑וֹם עַל־ כֵּ֥ן קָרָֽא־ שְׁמ֖וֹ גַּלְעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lā·ḇān hag·gal haz·zeh ‘êḏ bê·nî ū·ḇê·nə·ḵā hay·yō·wm ‘al- kên qā·rā- šə·mōw gal·‘êḏ
verses.literal: Then Laban declared This mound is a witness between you and me this day Therefore . . . the place was called . . . Galeed
verses.literalPt: Então disse Labão: Este montão seja hoje por testemunha entre mim e ti. Por isso se lhe chamou Galeede,

verses.original: וְהַמִּצְפָּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֔ר יִ֥צֶף יְהוָ֖ה בֵּינִ֣י וּבֵינֶ֑ךָ כִּ֥י נִסָּתֵ֖ר אִ֥ישׁ מֵרֵעֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ham·miṣ·pāh ’ă·šer ’ā·mar yi·ṣep̄ Yah·weh bê·nî ū·ḇê·ne·ḵā kî nis·sā·ṯêr ’îš mê·rê·‘ê·hū
verses.literal: It was also called Mizpah because Laban said May the LORD keep watch between you and me when we are absent from each other . . .
verses.literalPt: E Mispá, porquanto disse: Atente o SENHOR entre mim e ti, quando nós estivermos apartados um do outro.

verses.original: אִם־ תְּעַנֶּ֣ה אֶת־ בְּנֹתַ֗י וְאִם־ תִּקַּ֤ח נָשִׁים֙ עַל־ בְּנֹתַ֔י אֵ֥ין אִ֖ישׁ עִמָּ֑נוּ רְאֵ֕ה אֱלֹהִ֥ים עֵ֖ד בֵּינִ֥י וּבֵינֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- tə·‘an·neh ’eṯ- bə·nō·ṯay wə·’im- tiq·qaḥ nā·šîm ‘al- bə·nō·ṯay ’ên ’îš ‘im·mā·nū rə·’êh ’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘êḏ bê·nî ū·ḇê·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: If you mistreat my daughters or take other . . . wives although no one is with us remember that God is a witness between you and me . . .
verses.literalPt: Se afligires as minhas filhas, e se tomares mulheres além das minhas filhas, ninguém está conosco; atenta que Deus é testemunha entre mim e ti.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר לָבָ֖ן לְיַעֲקֹ֑ב הִנֵּ֣ה׀ הַגַּ֣ל הַזֶּ֗ה וְהִנֵּה֙ הַמַצֵּבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָרִ֖יתִי בֵּינִ֥י וּבֵינֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lā·ḇān lə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ hin·nêh hag·gal haz·zeh wə·hin·nêh ha·maṣ·ṣē·ḇå̄h ’ă·šer yā·rî·ṯî bê·nî ū·ḇê·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: Laban also said to Jacob Here is the . . . mound and here is the pillar I have set up between you and me . . .
verses.literalPt: Disse mais Labão a Jacó: Eis aqui este mesmo montão, e eis aqui essa coluna que levantei entre mim e ti.

verses.original: עֵ֚ד הַגַּ֣ל הַזֶּ֔ה וְעֵדָ֖ה הַמַּצֵּבָ֑ה אִם־ אָ֗נִי לֹֽא־ אֶֽעֱבֹ֤ר אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ אֶת־ הַגַּ֣ל הַזֶּ֔ה וְאִם־ אַ֠תָּה לֹא־ תַעֲבֹ֨ר אֵלַ֜י אֶת־ הַגַּ֥ל הַזֶּ֛ה וְאֶת־ הַמַּצֵּבָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את לְרָעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘êḏ hag·gal haz·zeh wə·‘ê·ḏāh ham·maṣ·ṣê·ḇāh ’im- ’ā·nî lō- ’e·‘ĕ·ḇōr ’ê·le·ḵā ’eṯ- hag·gal haz·zeh wə·’im- ’at·tāh lō- ṯa·‘ă·ḇōr ’ê·lay ’eṯ- hag·gal haz·zeh wə·’eṯ- ham·maṣ·ṣê·ḇāh haz·zōṯ lə·rā·‘āh
verses.literal: This mound is a witness and this pillar is a witness that I will not go past this . . . mound to harm you and you will not go past . . . this mound and pillar to harm me
verses.literalPt: Este montão seja testemunha, e esta coluna seja testemunha, que eu não passarei este montão a ti, e que tu não passarás este montão e esta coluna a mim, para mal.

verses.original: אֱלֹהֵ֨י אַבְרָהָ֜ם וֵֽאלֹהֵ֤י נָחוֹר֙ יִשְׁפְּט֣וּ בֵינֵ֔ינוּ אֱלֹהֵ֖י אֲבִיהֶ֑ם וַיִּשָּׁבַ֣ע יַעֲקֹ֔ב בְּפַ֖חַד אָבִ֥יו יִצְחָֽק׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lō·hê ’aḇ·rā·hām wê·lō·hê nā·ḥō·wr yiš·pə·ṭū ḇê·nê·nū ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·ḇî·hem way·yiš·šā·ḇa‘ ya·‘ă·qōḇ bə·p̄a·ḥaḏ ’ā·ḇîw yiṣ·ḥāq
verses.literal: May the God of Abraham and the God of Nahor the God of their father judge between us So Jacob swore by the Fear of his father Isaac
verses.literalPt: O Deus de Abraão e o Deus de Naor, o Deus de seu pai, julgue entre nós. E jurou Jacó pelo temor de seu pai Isaque.

verses.original: וַיִּזְבַּ֨ח יַעֲקֹ֥ב זֶ֙בַח֙ בָּהָ֔ר וַיִּקְרָ֥א לְאֶחָ֖יו לֶאֱכָל־ לָ֑חֶם וַיֹּ֣אכְלוּ לֶ֔חֶם וַיָּלִ֖ינוּ בָּהָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiz·baḥ ya·‘ă·qōḇ ze·ḇaḥ bā·hār way·yiq·rā lə·’e·ḥāw le·’ĕ·ḵāl- lā·ḥem way·yō·ḵə·lū le·ḥem way·yā·lî·nū bā·hār
verses.literal: Then Jacob offered a sacrifice on the mountain and invited his relatives to eat a meal And after they had eaten . . . they spent the night on the mountain
verses.literalPt: E ofereceu Jacó um sacrifício na montanha, e convidou seus irmãos, para comer pão; e comeram pão e passaram a noite na montanha.

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֨ם לָבָ֜ן בַּבֹּ֗קֶר וַיְנַשֵּׁ֧ק לְבָנָ֛יו וְלִבְנוֹתָ֖יו וַיְבָ֣רֶךְ אֶתְהֶ֑ם וַיֵּ֛לֶךְ וַיָּ֥שָׁב לָבָ֖ן לִמְקֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaš·kêm lā·ḇān bab·bō·qer way·naš·šêq lə·ḇā·nāw wə·liḇ·nō·w·ṯāw way·ḇā·reḵ ’eṯ·hem way·yê·leḵ way·yā·šāḇ lā·ḇān lim·qō·mōw
verses.literal: Early the next morning Laban got up and kissed his grandchildren and daughters and blessed them Then he left to return home
verses.literalPt: E levantou-se Labão pela manhã de madrugada, e beijou seus filhos e suas filhas e abençoou-os e partiu; e voltou Labão ao seu lugar.
